tidbit: Did you know… one story this hour was carried by two different outlets in the last few hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Nvidia's Flora cuts robot video labeling costs to 72 cents per hour, reported by The Decoder.
The ECP proposes 12 amendments to regulate artificial intelligence and curb misuse in elections, confirmed by The Express Tribune.
Reservoir sues Suno and Anthropic over alleged copyright infringement, seeking nearly 340 million dollars, reported by CelebrityAccess.
Grok Bot can now place calls, take notes, and send summaries, with real-world use in Tesla and Starlink, reported by BASENOR - Tesla Accessories.
Grok and GPT-6.1 recommend opposing candidates in U.S. election prompts, with 92 percent and 97 percent favoring Republicans and Democrats respectively, reported by AI Insider.
Free every hour.
